author: Vertyco
description:
Manage PalWorld dedicated servers via the official REST API. Join/leave logging, a live status panel with per-server player counts, playtime and session tracking, player lookups with name/IP history, and admin controls (announce, kick, ban, save, shutdown).
**REQUIRES A POSTGRES INSTANCE**
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores PalWorld game player data (names, platform user IDs, IP addresses, sessions, playtime). It does not store Discord user data.
install_msg:
# PalTools
Requires a Postgres instance. After loading, run `[p]paltools postgres` to set connection info, then `[p]paltools servers` to add your PalWorld servers (RESTAPIEnabled=True required in PalWorldSettings.ini). Player IPs are collected for moderation; see the README.
short: PalWorld server management via REST API
